## Close Won

The spec's differentiator, as a command: mark a Deal/Opportunity `closed won` and flow it onward with no manual handoff — activates a yearly **Subscription** on the deal's account at the deal value and creates the **first draft Invoice** (30-day terms, one line item, linked to the subscription, owner carried over from the deal).

The **Contract** step of the chain is deferred until the Contract block exists (v1.1) — the command says so in its result message. Compound values (price, lineItems) are patched as JSON after save rather than constructed as field instances.

Commands cannot hold `containedExamples` — the linked example is the natural target: a deal in negotiation.

**Non-goals:** contract generation (v1.1 Recommend flow), proration/mid-cycle billing, multi-currency conversion.
